item.title: A check-in when wearable data goes quiet
item.summary: Murph now checks in when more daily wearable sources stop sending data, including Fitbit, Oura and Ultrahuman.
item.details: After a source has delivered data, Murph can send one private iMessage check-in after five quiet days, or three for Apple Health, if you have messaged recently. You can ask to wait 5–30 days or stop these check-ins while keeping syncing on. Workout apps, scales and glucose systems are excluded.
